candidates.original_title: Assessment of household food waste in Hungary
candidates.description: The original study measured the quantity and composition of food waste generated by Hungarian households using the FUSIONS methodology over a one-week period.
candidates.citation_sentence: The actual study is a replication of the first Hungarian measurement-based research conducted in 2016 [24], which we regarded as a baseline for comparison.
candidates.notes: The paper explicitly identifies this as a replication using the same methodology and reports broadly similar results, but states that it was not organized or suitable as a validation of replicability.
